title: 云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 七十章 盟约云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 七十一章 真假
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
众神霄派弟子一边戟指叱骂，一边拔剑请缨，跃跃欲试。
一个贵族打扮的金国少年冷冷道：“这些妖魔敬酒不吃吃罚酒，国师何必与他们客气？只消乱炮将他们轰死便是。”
他背手昂立，神容傲慢，显是鞑子首领，说的大宋官话虽带了些古怪的腔调，却也算咬字清晰。
王文卿道：“小王爷少安毋躁。这些人身上藏了莫大的秘密，上关天道玄理，下涉苍生社稷，倘能问将出来，覆灭宋朝指日可待。贫道与他们总算多年旧识，假若他们执迷不悟，再行动手，也算对得起故交之情。”
许宣心想：“他说的秘密多半便是那什么‘神霄五雷谱’和百派心法了，与苍生社稷又有什么相干？这贼道士身为大宋国师，为了一己私欲，不惜背主卖国，连金鞑子也被他耍弄于股掌之间，奸猾之至。”大为厌憎。
林灵素纵声大笑道：“奶奶的故交之情！眼下漫天雷电，正是我神霄派立剑扬威之时，有种就上来和老子决一生死。像个娘儿们似的唧唧歪歪的，说什么狗屁废话？”
轰雷滚滚，他运足中气，一字字地清晰传到众人耳中，双手突然扳住那条鲨鱼的巨口，上下一掀，猛地将它撕为两半，顺势翻身旋腿，“嘭嘭”连声，将三只围上的虎鲨踢得血肉四炸，冲天飞起。
这几下迅猛如雷霆，看得许宣又惊又佩，小青更是凉浸浸的尽是冷汗。均想：这魔头经脉尽断，形如废人，竟仍有如此神力！亏得自己先前尚未动手，否则说不定已经身首异处了！
王文卿摇头道：“灵萼兄，你重伤未愈，对付区区几条鲨鱼尚且如此费力，又如何与我相战？就算你不念故情，我也不可趁人之危。同室操戈，岂不成了天下人的笑柄？”
当下也不管他如何挑衅嘲骂，指挥着五艘大船徐徐变阵，绕转包抄，将四人围夹在中央。
洪波跌宕，群鲨穿梭，浮板飘摇如叶。许宣见他们既不开炮，也不上前，心反而如悬半空，忐忑不已。
林灵素冷笑传音道：“放心吧，这狗贼生性多疑，就算知道老子唱的是空城计，若无十二分的把握，也绝不敢轻举妄动。你们要想活命，就老老实实地听我安排。”
从怀中取出那图轴，高声道：“很好，你既然不想再斗，那我们就兑现当年的约定。你要的东西就在这里。《五雷谱》也罢，‘百派心法’也好，全都出自此图。只要你指天立誓，答应老子三个条件，这‘炼天石图’我便双手奉上。”
听得“炼天石图”四字，众船登即哗然。
小青想不到他竟会将秘图拱手让人，心下大急，奈何这魔头真气强猛依旧，四周又强敌环伺，别说自己无力夺占，就算真能伺机抢来，也只是白白搭上一条性命。
漫天闪电纵横，遍海蓝紫。
那五艘大船越驶越近，王文卿微笑道：“这就是了。你我若早点这般开诚布公，又怎会生出这许多的波澜？只要这‘炼天石图’是真的，别说三个条件，就算三百个又有何妨？”
林灵素嘴角冷笑，高声道：“这三个条件再也简单不过。第一，你我既已罢战，绝不可再反悔动手。李元君也好，这两丫头小子也罢，和老子在同一条船上，你们也不可再动他们半根毫毛。”
王文卿点头道：“那是自然。他们既是灵萼兄的至友亲朋，也就是我们的客人，自当同舟共济，好生招待。”
林灵素道：“第二，你我无论谁先悟出飞升之道，都要原原本本地告知对方，绝不能有半点欺瞒。”

王文卿道：“当年我们结拜兄弟时，就曾说过此节。若不是灵萼兄瞒我在先，我又何至如此？只要你肯指天发誓，我也绝不食言。”
林灵素道：“很好。第三，我与赵宋狗皇帝有不共戴天之仇，你既成了鞑子的国师，鞑子又对中原虎视眈眈，不如联起手，一齐将赵宋灭了，刨出那狗皇帝的祖陵，开棺戮尸，诛杀九族！”说到最后一句时，双眼怒火欲喷，一字字似从齿缝间挤迸而出。
王文卿还未应答，那金国小王爷已傲然道：“这事不必国师奏请，本王便可答应你。你是国师的师兄弟，必定也有通天本事，只要能助我大金覆灭赵宋，要多少金帛牛马、官爵米禄，全都不在话下。”
王文卿微笑道：“灵萼兄，小王爷是当今大金国太师兼都元帅的公子，他的话就如同圣旨。他答应你的事情，可比我管用百倍。”
content_en:
The disciples of the Shenxiao Sect raised their halberds and scolded, while drawing their swords and asking for their tassels, eager to try.
A young man from the Kingdom of Jin dressed as a noble said coldly: "These monsters don't have to drink wine to toast them. Why should the imperial master be polite to them? Just blast them to death with random cannons."
He stood upright with his hands behind his back and looked arrogant, clearly a Tatar leader. Although he spoke the official dialect of the Song Dynasty with some weird accents, he was still clear.
Wang Wenqing said: "Young prince, please be patient. These people hide great secrets, which are related to the mysteries of heaven and earth, and to the common people and the country. If we can ask the generals to find out, the overthrow of the Song Dynasty will be just around the corner. After all, I have known them for many years. If they persist in their obsession and take action again, they will be worthy of their old friendship."
Xu Xuan thought to himself: "Most of the secrets he talked about were the 'Five Thunder Spectra of Shenxiao' and the mental methods of hundreds of schools. What does it have to do with the common people and the country? This thief Taoist priest, as a national master of the Song Dynasty, did not hesitate to betray his master and the country for his own selfish desires. Even the Jin Tatars were manipulated by him. He was so cunning." He was very disgusted.
Lin Lingsu laughed loudly and said: "Grandma's old friendship! The sky is full of thunder and lightning. It's the time when my Shenxiao sect is setting up its sword to show off its power. If you feel like it, you can come up and fight me to the death. What nonsense are you talking about like a bitch?"
The thunder was rolling, and he used enough energy to clearly convey each word to everyone's ears. He suddenly grabbed the shark's huge mouth with both hands, lifted it up and down, and violently tore it into two halves. He turned over and rotated his legs. With a continuous "bang bang" sound, he kicked the three surrounding tiger sharks until their flesh and blood exploded and flew into the sky.
These few blows were as fast as thunder, Xu Xuan was shocked and admired, and Xiao Qing was so cold that she broke into a cold sweat. They all thought: This demon's meridians have been cut off and he looks like a disabled person, but he still has such divine power! Fortunately, he hadn't taken action before, otherwise he might have been dead!
Wang Wenqing shook his head and said: "Brother Ling'e, you have not recovered from your serious injury. How can you fight with me even if you are struggling to deal with a few sharks? Even if you don't miss our old feelings, I can't take advantage of others' danger. If we are at war with each other, won't we become the laughing stock of the world?"
At the moment, regardless of how he provoked and taunted him, he commanded the five large ships to slowly change their formations, circle around and surround them, and trap the four people in the center.
The waves are ups and downs, sharks are passing through, and the floating board is swaying like leaves. Seeing that they neither fired nor stepped forward, Xu Xuan felt as if his heart was hanging in the air and was filled with uneasiness.
Lin Lingsu sneered and said, "Don't worry, this thief is suspicious by nature. Even if he knows that what I'm talking about is an empty city strategy, he will never dare to act rashly if he is not 120% sure. If you want to survive, just listen to my arrangements."
He took out the picture scroll from his arms and said loudly: "Very good, since you don't want to fight anymore, then we will fulfill the agreement we made back then. What you want is here. The "Five Thunder Spectrum" and the "Hundred Schools' Heart Techniques" all come from this picture. As long as you swear to the sky and agree to my three conditions, I will give you this "Heaven Refining Stone Picture" with both hands."
Hearing the four words "Heaven Refining Stone Picture", all the ships boarded and there was an uproar.
Xiao Qing didn't expect that he would hand over the secret map to someone else, and was very worried. However, the devil's true energy was still strong, and he was surrounded by powerful enemies. Not to mention that he was unable to seize it, even if he could seize the opportunity, his life would be in vain.
The sky is filled with lightning, and the sea is blue and purple.
The five large ships were getting closer and closer. Wang Wenqing smiled and said: "That's it. If you and I had been so open and honest earlier, how could there have been so many waves? As long as this 'Tianshi Stone Diagram' is true, let alone three conditions, what's the point of even three hundred?"
Lin Lingsu sneered at the corner of her mouth and said loudly: "These three conditions couldn't be simpler. First, since you and I have stopped fighting, we must never go back on our word. Li Yuanjun, or these two girls and boys, are in the same boat as me, and you can't touch them even a hair."
Wang Wenqing nodded and said: "That's natural. Since they are brother Ling'e's closest friends and relatives, they are also our guests. They should be in the same boat.Good luck, good hospitality. "
Lin Lingsu said: "Second, no matter who of you or me realizes the way to ascension first, we must tell the other party the truth without any deception. "
Wang Wenqing said: "We talked about this when we became sworn brothers. If Brother Ling'e hadn't hid it from me first, why would I be like this? As long as you are willing to swear to heaven, I will never break your promise. "
Lin Lingsu said: "Very good. Thirdly, I have a sworn feud with the Dog Emperor of Zhao Song. Since you have become the national counselor of the Tatars, and the Tatars are eyeing the Central Plains, why not join hands and destroy Zhao Song together, dig out the ancestral tomb of the Dog Emperor, open the coffin, kill the corpse, and kill the nine tribes! "When he said the last sentence, his eyes were filled with rage, and every word seemed to burst out from between his teeth.
Before Wang Wenqing could answer, the young prince of the Kingdom of Jin had already said proudly: "You don't need to ask the imperial master for this matter, I will agree to it. You are a senior fellow of the Imperial Preceptor, and you must have extraordinary abilities. As long as you can help me, Dajin, to overthrow Zhao and Song Dynasties, it doesn't matter how much gold, silk, cattle, horses, official rank, and salary you need. "
Wang Wenqing smiled and said: "Brother Linghe, the young prince is the son of the current Taishi and Marshal of the Kingdom of Jin. His words are like an imperial edict. What he promised you is a hundred times more effective than mine. "
